thread:
mira: Quick UX check: I'm proposing a 'Bulk Approve' keyboard shortcut (A) and a short undo toast that appears for 7s. Questions: toast copy, screenreader announcement behavior, and thresholds for requiring a confirmation modal (e.g., >100 items).
sam: shortcut sounds great for power users. worried about accidental keypresses while typing in other inputs. We should only trigger when focus is inside the run list and no editable input is focused.
olivia: microcopy proposal for toast: 'Approved 12 items. Undo' — concise. For larger batches maybe: 'Approved 243 items. Changes queued. Undo' so it doesn't look like instant network success for big jobs.
kevin: implementation notes: only listen for key when list container has tabindex=0 and aria-roledescription="item list". Example: `container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'a' && !isEditableFocused()) handleBulkApprove(); })` Also we should set `aria-live="assertive"` on the toast for SRs.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: assertive live announcements can be disruptive. Recommend `aria-live="polite"` for non-blocking toasts, but add `role="status"` with clear text. For large operations (>=100) announce 'Bulk approval started for 243 items' and then later announce completion.
mira: good point. maybe policy: if count < 25 -> optimistic approve + toast (polite), 25-100 -> show spinner and then completion toast, >100 -> open confirmation modal (requires click) and start background job with progress.
sam: sounds reasonable. also add an inline counter in the bulk toolbar that updates live so keyboard users see progress. aria-live="polite" on that counter.
olivia: toast wording variants for poll: 1) 'Approved 12 items — Undo' 2) '12 items approved. Undo' 3) 'Approved: 12 items. View changes' (last gives CTA). Which is clearest?
kevin: prefer variant 1 for brevity. For large batches we should avoid 'Approved' until backend confirms; show 'Approval started (243)  View progress' then update to 'Completed' when done.
qa-bot: test tasks created: 'bulk-approve-hotkey-focus-guard', 'bulk-approve-toasts-aria', 'bulk-approve-confirmation-thresholds'. Scheduling on next CI.
mira: UX nit: undo CTA should be inline in the toast and keyboard accessible (tabindex=0). If a user hits tab after approve, focus should move to undo button. Also ensure pressing Esc dismisses toast.
a11y-bot: add test to ensure screen reader sees toast text exactly once. Use axe-run for toast visibility.
sam: tiny visual nit: toast color for success should not rely solely on green—pair with icon + text to help colorblind users.
mira: agreed. Action items: 1) implement hotkey scoped to list focus only 2) toast polite with role=status for small batches, progressive messaging for medium/large 3) confirmation modal for >100 4) undo button tabbable and esc-dismissable 5) add live counter in toolbar with polite aria-live.
olivia: I'll run quick content ops poll with the 3 variants and post results here.
kevin: starting PR now. I'll include keyboard guard, aria-live examples, and unit tests for toast announce. ETA: tomorrow morning.
mira: thanks! I'll update the design mock with the undo toast layout and confirmation modal copy. Link PR when ready. :sparkles:
